distribution_layout.constant curve (types 2/8): values[0:2] = output range min/max, values[2] = start time, values[3] = time scale (samples per unit time); then N samples of 1 (float) or 3 (vector) floats, sample i at t = start + i / time_scale, linear between samples (UE3 FRawDistribution baking)
distribution_layout.uniform curve (types 4/10): same header; each sample holds two endpoints (2 or 6 floats)
